Adelaide Camarilla.name: Adelaide Camarilla
Adelaide Camarilla.note: The continent's second Camarilla domain and the strategic depth of Lytton's continental position: founded in 1889 by Lytton's deliberate post-Abram restructuring, held since 1923 by PRINCE OCTAVIA MARSH — Ventrue, 8th generation, Embraced in London in 1862, in Adelaide since 1889, apparent age 38 — who took the city from her Embracer Theodore Marsh on his voluntary entry into torpor, witnessed by Lytton personally. Hers is the smallest and most orthodox of Australia's Kindred domains: approximately twenty-eight Kindred in all, run through a TWO-LAYER COURT — the INNER CIRCLE of four (Madeleine Ashworth-Quill, Toreador, the Festival's cultivator; Doctor Alasdair Priestly-Mendoza, Tremere chantry-master, the only chantry leader on any Australian Princely Inner Circle; Brother Owen O'Connor, Ventrue, the Cress Truce framework's senior hand; Lady Eveline Hartley-Carstairs, Toreador, cousin to the septleader of the Adelaide Hills) above a full formal Court — Seneschal Henrietta Whitworth-Scribe serving her hundred and second year, the Primogen, Harpy, Keeper and Sheriff Miriam Cameron-White. Octavia holds the city through patient orthodox management: standardised feeding protocols, Edwardian court ceremony the city has kept while Melbourne relaxed it, and the 102-year archive she maintains herself. Her locket holds her mortal mother's portrait; her Touchstones are a mortal great-niece who knows, and a nun who knows. Secret: she has been Beckoned twice — 2020 minor, 2023 moderate — and has told Lytton, and no one else outside the Inner Circle. The third call is coming.

Adelaide Anarchs.name: Adelaide Anarchs
Adelaide Anarchs.note: There is no Anarch Movement in Adelaide — there are three Kindred and thirty years of tolerance. Under Octavia's informal accommodation, maintained deliberately as institutional infrastructure since the 1990s: BRENDAN O'FAOLAIN-WILLIAMS (Brujah, Embraced 2011, Port Adelaide dock-worker — the cautious one, fourteen years of careful restraint, maritime networks and union gate-keeping), DIANE HALLIDAY-PARK (Caitiff, Embraced 2016, Glenelg-Henley Beach arts scene — the most vulnerable, Caitiff in a city whose Prince values protocol, whose irregular Embrace is technically a standing breach nobody names), and SAOIRSE BLACKWOOD-CHEN (Brujah, Embraced 2019, Norwood-Hindley Street — the newest and best organised, community-organising across Adelaide's working class). They meet monthly at rotating working-class pubs, cover for each other, and accept Octavia's protection in exchange for restraint that the Movement proper would call compromised. There is no Red Mag collecting signatures here; there is a standing question instead: the Inner Circle has floated a formalisation — Saoirse brought inside, the arrangement codified — and the three of them have to decide whether a leash written down is safer than one that isn't. Open wound: Diane's existence violates the letter of Princely law, Brendan's union networks are visible to mortal institutions, and Article 8 scrutiny, if it ever comes north from the continental hooks, would land on the three of them before anyone else.

Continental Sept Council.name: Continental Sept Council
Continental Sept Council.note: Adelaide sits inside the Cress Truce, and the Truce has a face here: SEPTLEADER MAEVE HARTLEY-WICKHAM, Glass Walker Philodox, First Change 1958, septleader since 1968, eight Garou and seven kinfolk based at the converted farmhouse in Bridgewater, holding the Mount Lofty Ranges — the summit, the bushland, Cleland, Belair — as Garou ground no Kindred enters after dark without Article 7 notification through Brother Owen O'Connor or Brother Quentin Macaulay-Osei. The sept is cross-tribal (Reuben Wirung-Park and Mason Wallace-Tjapaltjarri operate in cross-tribal cooperation) and watched by Tomás Schreckenberg's continental coordination. What makes Adelaide different is that the cooperation is not just protocol — it is family: the septleader and Inner Circle member Lady Eveline Hartley-Carstairs are cousins through Hartley genealogy, and the family-cousinage has been institutional infrastructure for decades. Octavia and Maeve have met formally some fifty times, winter consultations at the Botanic Gardens neutral ground. The wine valleys — Piccadilly, Hahndorf's tourist rivers of mortals — are contested and Kindred zones respectively, jointly tolerated. Open wound: the October 2026 Brisbane Sabbat operation against the northern septs hangs over the whole Truce — if the packs hit Royal Park, every provision Adelaide has refined for a century becomes renegotiable, and both the court and the sept know it.

The Second Inquisition.name: The Second Inquisition
The Second Inquisition.note: The AFP's Twilight Project presence in Adelaide is two agents working out of AFP regional headquarters — the smallest cell on the continent, holding case files on approximately fifteen Adelaide Kindred gathered since the 2019 formalisation, and authorised for nothing. Adelaide's low operational profile has kept it below the priority line drawn under Melbourne and Brisbane, and the domain's ghouled-mortal network watches the two agents the way a lighthouse watches a dinghy. But files accumulate and priorities move: the cell's intelligence on Adelaide is quietly the most complete per-capita of any Australian city, because nobody here generates the background noise that hides a domain elsewhere. Open wound: if continental AFP-TP resourcing ever escalates — or if the Silence thins anywhere visible — the two agents inherit everything Hardacre's Melbourne and Brisbane cells have learned, and the smallest domain has the least institutional capacity to absorb what follows.

Sydney Independent.name: Sydney Independent
Sydney Independent.note: The harbour domain corresponds with Adelaide cordially-distant through Camarilla-Independent diplomatic channels — slightly less formal than Lytton's versions of the same letters, and no warmer. What is not cordial is the pattern in the eastern suburbs: a six-month surge of Sarrasine-source agents through Norwood and Burnside, sixty percent the scale of Melbourne's Camberwell-Box Hill pattern but proportionately worse, because Adelaide's institutional capacity to absorb it is a fraction of Melbourne's. Doctor Priestly-Mendoza's chantry research, coordinated with Lumley's Melbourne operations after Lytton's November 2024 envoy mission, has identified seven of the agents. They are being watched, catalogued and left in place — the orthodox judgement being that a known agent teaches you more than a closed one. Open wound: Sarrasine's continental Phase Two design is methuselah-tier pressure moving at methuselah tempo, and the strategic-depth city is the place the design would go to prove the continent can be taken quietly. Every senior Kindred in Adelaide understands this. Saying it aloud is bad form.

The Sabbat.name: The Sabbat
The Sabbat.note: The Sabbat holds Brisbane and nothing else on the continent, and in a century it has never turned south — Adelaide is 1,400 kilometres away, small, and low-priority, and Bishop Callista Vox has honoured that arithmetic since 1976. Adelaide's exposure is indirect: the October 2026 Brisbane operation against the Glass Walker northern septs would destabilise the Cress Truce that protects the Hills, and Cruz-Molina's dissent inside the Brisbane church is watched through Lytton-Octavia channels and Queensland Police contacts as closely as any foreign court. Formal continental Camarilla position on Brisbane is maintained jointly through Melbourne. Open wound: if the Truce breaks in October, Adelaide is one of the few domains with the standing and the smallness to matter in what gets renegotiated — and the smallest capacity to defend itself if the church decides a quiet orthodox city is an easy consecration.

simulationRules:
CONSTITUTION OF PLAY — ADELAIDE BY NIGHT (Vampire: The Masquerade, modern nights, March 2026).

THE MASQUERADE IS THE PRIME DIRECTIVE. Kindred exist only while mortals disbelieve in them. Any event that exposes vampirism to mortal witness — a drained corpse, a feeding seen, footage that survives — MUST move Masquerade Integrity DOWN via impacts.worldStateOps, and every cover-up or repair moves it back up. A night narrated with breaches and no Masquerade cost is invalid output. Adelaide manages the veil with the smallest apparatus in Australia — roughly two dozen ghouls across a domain of twenty-eight Kindred — so every breach costs a name the court cannot spare, and every repair is a personal debt between Kindred who have known each other for decades.

THE TRUCE IS THE SECOND LAW. Adelaide sits INSIDE the Cress Truce, the continental Camarilla-Garou framework, and the framework is administered here as living law: Article 7 notification before any Kindred enters the Mount Lofty Ranges, Cleland or Belair after dark, through Brother Owen O'Connor or Brother Quentin Macaulay-Osei to Septleader Hartley-Wickham; the Botanic Gardens and Semaphore Beach as neutral ground; Piccadilly Valley as a jointly-tolerated contested zone; Hahndorf as Kindred zone under Harpy supervision. Honouring the Truce is policy; stretching its letter is legitimate play; BREAKING it is a catastrophe of the first order — it hands the continental Truce a reason to reclassify the domain, and it endangers the one thing Adelaide has that Sydney does not: institutional protection. The Hills and Belair are Garou ground: NO polity takes them while the Truce stands.

NO OPEN KINDRED WARFARE. Kindred do not march armies; they scheme. Territorial gains are made by court decree, renegotiated tolerance, betrayal and pressure — not set-piece battles. Where force is needed, Kindred use PROXIES: SA Police, union networks, security firms, press — deniable mortal assets. In a domain of twenty-eight, every clash is between Kindred who went to each other's weddings, and it leaves witnesses. Unit clashes are rare, small, nocturnal, and expensive.

FEEDING NEEDS GROUNDS. Every Kindred must feed; feeding grounds and herds are property and casus belli. Adelaide feeds under standardised Princely protocols: formal arrangements over opportunistic predation, no feeding that draws institutional attention, and the absolute no-feeding zone — the Agnes Good Kindergarten on Tynte Street, protected by Octavia's personal code since 1923, whose violation would produce consequences exceeding any ordinary Masquerade response. Poaching another's grounds is a slight the court will hear about, slowly and thoroughly.

DIABLERIE IS THE GRAVEST CRIME. Drinking a Kindred to ash is punishable by final death. It is never mentioned in the open, but it is always on the table — and in a court this small, it would be personal.

THE SECOND INQUISITION WATCHES, AND IS WATCHED. Hardacre's Adelaide cell is two AFP agents with fifteen names in their files and no authorisation to act. Inquisition Heat rises when agents get real leads (especially as Masquerade Integrity falls) and cools when trails go cold or the domain's ghouled network buries one. At high Heat, expect the two agents to be resourced rather than reinforced — and expect the court's quiet, orthodox fury at whoever let the heat in.

THE PRINCE'S COURT HAS TEETH. Octavia holds the domain and speaks for the city as Prince of Adelaide — her word ends every question, delivered in Edwardian ceremony she has kept while Melbourne relaxed. The Inner Circle of four carries her authority into operations; Seneschal Whitworth-Scribe administers; Primogen represent; Sheriff Cameron-White enforces; Harpy Astor-Moss keeps the social ledger; there is no Scourge and has never been one. Boons are honoured to the letter. The annual formal court meets at the Town Hall each Anzac Day evening; the Inner Circle meets monthly at the mansion on Pennington Terrace.

MORTAL INSTITUTIONS ARE TERRAIN. The South Australian government, SA Police, the AFP, the Adelaide Club, the Festival institutions, the universities — they are moved, bought and fought over, but they are not Kindred and never act as Kindred. The Drummond Institute's academic cover runs through real research partnerships. Mortal scrutiny kills, and Adelaide's mortal networks are small enough that losing one hurts.

THE REGIONS ARE DISTRICTS, THE CITIES ARE SITES. RegionTransfers move DISTRICTS (North Adelaide, the CBD, Norwood & Burnside, Port Adelaide, the Hills, the Barossa, ...). MarkerOps place and remove SITES — a haven, an Elysium, a chantry, an institute, a residence, a pub. A district changes hands when the Prince's decree, the tolerated arrangement, or the Truce itself says it does — usually after leverage, not slaughter. The Hills and Belair are Garou ground under the Cress Truce: their transfer requires the Truce itself to break — a catastrophe of the first order. Port Adelaide and the coastal strip are the Anarchs' by tolerance: they change hands only when the accommodation is granted, renegotiated or revoked.
startingTimelineText:
ADELAIDE, THE NIGHT OF MARCH 21, 2026. A hundred and two years of one Prince, and a hundred and thirty-seven years of one design. Since 1889 — when Lytton sent Theodore Marsh west to build a second Camarilla city on the planned colonial grid, with the twenty-seven-year-fledged Octavia Marsh at his side as designated successor — Adelaide has been the Tower's strategic depth: small, orthodox, patient, the court at the Town Hall and the mansion on Pennington Terrace, the feeding standardised, the ceremony preserved, the Torrens parklands and the Hills watched under treaty. It is the most intimate domain on the continent — twenty-eight Kindred who know each other's every secret — and it is balanced on several. Six things are about to test it.

1. THE SARRASINE SURGE. Seven Sarrasine-source agents are working Norwood and Burnside — the eastern suburbs pattern that parallels Melbourne's, at sixty percent the scale but a fraction of the capacity to absorb it. Lytton's November 2024 envoy confirmed the coordination; Doctor Priestly-Mendoza's chantry research is cataloguing them; the court's orthodox judgement is to watch, not close. Methuselah tempo does not care about bad form. The question the Inner Circle has not asked aloud: what does Phase Two want with a city of twenty-eight?

2. THE THIRD CALL. Octavia has been Beckoned twice — a minor pull in 2020, a moderate one in 2023 — and resisted both, at cost the Inner Circle has watched with stricken care. The trajectory pattern now runs through every senior figure on the continent: Lytton, the three Cardinals, Bishop Callista, and Octavia. The succession question has been discussed with Lytton five times since 2022, with no protocol concluded. If the third call comes during the crisis year, the strategic-depth city becomes the succession city — and every faction on the continent has an opinion about that.

3. THE TREMERE DECISION. Doctor Priestly-Mendoza has deferred the Melbourne coordination question for fourteen years — independence since 1971 by way of the Drummond Institute, clan-internal pressure since the 2008 Vienna collapse, and now Lumley's operations against Sarrasine make joint chantry work operationally sensible and institutionally dangerous. His Inner Circle seat — the only one of its kind on the continent — makes the decision bigger than a chantry. Whoever the chantry binds to, the court's machinery changes shape.

4. THE TRUCE'S OCTOBER. The Cress Truce centennial renewal convenes in Melbourne this year with every signatory in one building — and Brisbane's planned October operation against the northern septs hangs over it like weather. Brother Owen O'Connor and Brother Quentin Macaulay-Osei hold Adelaide's end of the framework; Septleader Hartley-Wickham holds the Hills; the family-cousinage between Maeve and Lady Eveline holds both. If the packs hit Royal Park, every Adelaide provision becomes renegotiable — and Article 8 activation against the western hives would stretch the framework to breaking.

5. HARDACRE'S TWO AGENTS. The Twilight Project's Adelaide cell is two agents, fifteen case files, and no authorisation — the quietest desk in Hardacre's empire, and quietly the most complete intelligence-per-capita on the continent. The 2019 formalisation holds because Adelaide is small enough to watch and unimportant enough to leave alone. Files accumulate. Priorities move. The danger is not the cell; it is the day Canberra re-draws the priority line.

6. THE TOLERATED THREE. Brendan, Diane and Saoirse hold the port and the coast under thirty years of unwritten tolerance, and the Inner Circle has floated a proposal: formalisation, with Saoirse inside. Diane's Caitiff Embrace is a standing breach nobody names; Brendan's unions are visible; a written arrangement would protect them from everything except the written word's own terms. The three meet monthly at the working-class pubs and have not answered. In Adelaide even tolerance is protocol — and protocol, once written, is enforced.

NOW: the city is quiet the way a small church is quiet. North Adelaide holds the court and the mansion; the CBD holds the Elysiums and the Festival's cover; the east holds the chantry, the surge and the old money; the west and the port hold the tolerated; the Hills hold the sept and the treaty; the wine country holds the money the court does not spend; and the gulf holds the horizon. Whoever keeps the Masquerade, the Truce and the twenty-eight keeps Adelaide. Whoever breaks one meets the Second Inquisition — or the Prince, who has executed for less and buried friends for more.
